_notes: Input of script/hardened/RedeployLayers.s.sol for the redeploy of 2026-11 (docs/redeploy-2026-11-gas.md).

previous*: the contracts that run now, from deploy/deployments/sepolia-pls943.json. The script reads from them every value that the new contracts keep (light clients, gates, Capella era, Gloas slot, cutoff, flow limiter, home chain name, wrapped native token, reward and failed delivery addresses).

deployerNonce: read it with `cast nonce <deployer> --rpc-url <alias>` right before the run. The script refuses a different nonce, because the bridges and the mediators name their twins on the other chain by predicted address.

deployer: the address of the keystore that signs (cast wallet address --account "$KEYSTORE_NAME"); the script refuses another signer. The running contracts were deployed by 0xF71cBAA5a165fad2FfFf6B0D68E84D67b1f75eAc; either account may deploy the new layers (docs/redeploy-2026-11-gas.md, before the run, step 3).

Layers mode creates eight contracts on each chain, at deployerNonce to deployerNonce + 7: ReceiptProofLib, OpeningProofLib, BeaconLayoutLib, MessageBridge, MediatorPayloads, TokenFactory, TokenMediator, DeliveryRouter (the split for the EIP-7825 gas cap).
Foundry resolves rpcAlias from FOUNDRY_RPC_ENDPOINTS, as for DeployBridge (docs/testnet-run.md). Never write a key into this file.
